campgroundName: Golden Ears Provincial Park - Alouette Campground / Gold Creek Campground
note: Camp 53 数据块覆盖 Alouette(含 North/South)+Gold Creek+North Beach 共4个区域;Gold Creek 是营地内一个独立 Loop,因此评价同时采集 Golden Ears 公园及 Gold Creek Campground 条目,并标注 area。TripAdvisor 页面为公园整体(4.6★,353条),Google/Wanderlog 为公园整体(4.7★,4632条),Campendium 为 Gold Creek Campground(4.0★,1条)。

reviews.author: UnrepentantFoodie
reviews.text: Spent one night at the Gold Creek campground on a sold-out Sunday night. We also toured the Allouette campground. Both campgrounds are dry (no elec, water, sewer). Very different topographies. Gold Creek is fairly flat making sites good for groups of family or friends reserving adjacent sites--but don't expect much privacy. Easy areas for children to play in, too. Just don't expect a lot of privacy, even though sites are nicely distanced. It's just that you can see a long way from wherever you are, including the Shower building which is very well lit at night--and annoying from site TD58, where we were. All sites are partial shade, and the roads are asphalt-paved. The beach is a close walk away. In summer, it's full of kids. Alouette is hilly and looks older (but it may not be) because the roads are gravel, not paved. The elevation changes offer more privacy and the trees are more dense. Probably less interesting for small kids, and could be an issue for handicapped campers.
reviews.textCn: Gold Creek 地势平坦适合亲友相邻扎营但私密性差;TD58 对着晚上灯很亮的淋浴房很受干扰;Alouette 起伏地形树木更密私密性更好
reviews.title: Beautiful park

reviews.author: sharon c
reviews.text: Golden Ears park is one of the most peaceful spots to camp. Short walk to the lake. The drive up from Maple Ridge takes you into the heart of nature. You are a short drive from the city to get natures beauty and enjoy the tranquility of mother nature
reviews.textCn: 最宁静的营地之一,湖很近,离城市很近却深入自然
reviews.title: Campers delight

reviews.author: Sandie Z
reviews.text: In the forest right outside of Maple Ridge BC. Lots if trees. Walking paths, lake, clean well places tv sites. Washroom needs updating or better cleaning but good otherwise. Not many camping in September but quiet we liked that. Is in the flight path of airport. We'd go back again. Hard to get wood. The trucks kept passing our site and others for fire pit.
reviews.textCn: 9月人少安静,厕所需要翻新,有飞机航线噪音,买柴火困难,会再来
reviews.title: In the woods close to Vancouver

reviews.author: Char M
reviews.text: This was our first time at Golden Ears and were very excited to be so close to such a beautiful lake. We read over the BC Parks description of each the campsite and decided that we wanted a site along Gold Creek and close to the lake so we book North Beach Campground. The campsite diagram gave us the impression that we would have easy access to the creek and the lake. When we arrived we discovered that we were indeed along the creek, but 200 feet above it (with a very steep drop/hill) with no access to the creek from our site. Also, we found the road to the lake at the top of a very steep hill which we did venture down. Unfortunately, I had knee problems for the next two days and the walk back up the hill was quite difficult. Additional, there is no drinking water available at this campground and you need to drive over to a different campground to get it.
reviews.textCn: North Beach 营位在溪流上方60米陡坡,无饮用水要去别的营地取,行动不便者慎选
reviews.title: Limited Lake Access for Seniors with Mobility Issues

reviews.author: kellinah
reviews.text: Beautiful area but DO NOT CAMP AT S8 in Gold Creek Campground. Children screaming and crying all night, it is right across from the washroom so there are people cutting through the plot to get to the toilets, you can hear the toilet flushing LOUD every 5 seconds, and there is no privacy. NOT GOOD FOR COUPLES WHO WANT PRIVACY. The site would be great for families who don't mind crying babies, but not for those who are not yet parents or don't like children. There is absolutely no cell reception, which was very nice. And the area is very beautiful. This plot is just terrible, you hear people talking on their way to the washroom all night, flushing, and walking through your plot to take a shortcut. We are supposed to spend another night tonight but we left early.
reviews.textCn: S8 正对厕所,夜里冲水声不断,游人穿营地抄近道,无私密性,提前退营;但全园无手机信号反而很喜欢
reviews.title: DO NOT CAMP AT S8 in Gold Creek Campground

reviews.author: esthert424
reviews.text: We first tried to visit the park on a Sunday but BC hydro was turning people away as the parking lots were closed. We returned on a weekday and did the Gold Creek trail hike. It was very leisurely and any fitness level should have no problem enjoying it. The walk is suitable for strollers and wheelchairs and there were many families out and about enjoying it. Be sure to visit during the week to ensure you are able to even enter the park. I'd like to return and visit alouette lake!
reviews.textCn: Gold Creek 步道轻松适合推车轮椅,建议工作日来(周末停车场满会限流)
reviews.title: Gold creek campsite

reviews.author: nurseneuf
reviews.text: lots of hiking for a variety of fitness levels. several beach accesses, depending on driving vs hiking to it. gorgeous forest, stunning mountains and clean pleasant lake. parking at the very end of the road doesn't ever seem to be big enough and can get pretty crammed on weekends.
reviews.textCn: 各难度步道都有,森林湖泊漂亮,周末尽头停车场不够
reviews.title: Gold creek campsite

reviews.author: skevans
reviews.text: This really IS the "woods" and yes- Goldilocks- there ARE bears (and cougars) so again- don't go traipsing off alone and think about how to bear-cache your food. Anyway- back to the beaches. I have been going to Alouette Lake for 40 years and although they SADLY removed several beautiful old conifers along the beach (bring the sunscreen for sure) this lake is stunning. It is common to see Bald Eagles spiraling overhead, there is fishing in the lake. swimming area is clean but cold. No life guard on duty but clearly defined boundaries marked with buoys. Watch the dam to the right of the swim area. Restrooms and change rooms are clean- there is also an outdoor shower. Canada Geese can be a bit of an issue.
reviews.textCn: 有熊和美洲狮,食物必须防熊储存;常有秃鹰,湖泳区冷但干净无救生员,大雁较多
reviews.title: Unplug your kids and go outside and play!

reviews.author: Luv2Travel8473
reviews.text: We didn't have time for a long stay but were able to have a good swim before the sun went down too far. The scenery at the beach is phenomenal and you feel so small amongst it all. It is beautiful and there are walkways along the beach to the washrooms which are proper washrooms with running water - not outhouse style! The beach was beautiful and the water was so clear - I didn't want to leave. Next time we'll make it an all day trip!
reviews.textCn: 沙滩风景壮观,水清,有自来水冲水厕所不是旱厕
reviews.title: Alouette campground/ Golden Ears Park

reviews.author: Denise M
reviews.text: Golden Ears Park is beautiful. The hike to the lower falls is about an hour long each way through the park rain forest. Great for all levels. Most of the hour is spent taking photos along the way. Kayaking is great, rates are reasonable. Hiking up to Golden Ears is about an estimated 7 hour hike one way. To do it you have to camp over night. Entrance to park is free but there is a charge for camping overnight.
reviews.textCn: Lower Falls 雨林徒步单程约1小时各级别都可,皮划艇好且便宜,进园免费露营收费
reviews.title: Alouette campground/ Golden Ears Park

reviews.author: jobatis
reviews.text: An excellent park with lots of recreation area, beach and the possibility of swimming... Tables for lunching and the possibility of boat rentals... Magnificent views everywhere...I recommend for families with children...
reviews.textCn: 强烈推荐带孩子,沙滩可游泳,可租船,到处风景壮美

reviews.author: Nav C
reviews.text: This is one of my favourite spots to visit at any time of year, the views are amazing! Great picnic spots and beach for those without furbabies. No where really to go with your dogs, limited picnic tables where dogs are allowed.
reviews.textCn: 四季都爱,但带狗不方便,允许狗的野餐桌很少

reviews.author: Clare T
reviews.text: Golden Ears is an amazing park with great hiking trails, beautiful beach and Mountain views to take your breath away. Wild life aplenty and a a spectacular drive into the park.
reviews.textCn: 徒步沙滩山景都一流,野生动物多,进园路风景壮观
reviews.title: Great Camping at Gold Creek!

reviews.text: Golden Ears Provincial Park is one of the closest parks to Vancouver, so despite the massive campgrounds with a combined 443 front country campsites, it can still get full on a summer weekend. In fact, it's so popular that in the peak season, BC Parks imposes a free day pass system for day users for Golden Ears. The biggest campgrounds: Alouette and Gold Creek are pretty similar, with deluxe camping amenities (hot shower, flush toilets, playgrounds) albeit somewhat dated. The campsites are generally quite large and spaced out, with very decent privacy. The kids-friendly Lower Gold Creek Falls Trail is ultra popular and worth a visit - if you can get a parking spot.
reviews.textCn: 共443个营位夏季周末仍爆满;Alouette/Gold Creek 设施齐全(热水澡/冲水厕/游乐场)但略旧;营位大而私密;Lower Falls 步道极热门
reviews.title: Camping at Golden Ears Provincial Park

reviews.text: The map makes it look like the campground is close to Alouette Lake, so H10, H11, and H12 sites are pretty popular, being the ones 'closest to the lake' on the campground map. But campers would be disappointed to find that the campground is 40 meters above the lake level behind dense woods, so you can't actually even see the lake. The trail to Campers Beach is about 800 meters long from this campground. The Gold Creek Walk-in Campsites enjoys a constant soothing noise of the nearby Gold Creek. A word of caution if you have a little explorer on your hands: make sure they don't venture too far off the gravel campsite. There is a sudden drop-off only a few meters from the campsite on the outer perimeters.
reviews.textCn: 步行营地H10-12看着近湖实则高40米密林看不见湖;Gold Creek 水声常伴;外圈营位边缘有陡降,带娃注意
reviews.title: Gold Creek Walk-In Campsites at Golden Ears Provincial Park

reviews.text: All three campgrounds are in lush, green forests with Douglas Fir and Western Cedar trees. The forest floor is covered in green, moss and ferns. The campsites are big and level with nice picnic tables. There is no electricity or water on site. The campground rangers are nice, but with limited knowledge. We camped here three days.
reviews.textCn: 三个营地都在茂密雨林中,营位大而平整,无水电,护林员友善但知识有限
reviews.title: Gold Creek Campground, British Columbia

reviews.author: Arvind M
reviews.text: Golden Ears Park is a true gem in Maple Ridge! The park offers an incredible variety of outdoor experiences, making it perfect for nature lovers. The trails are well-maintained, ranging from easy walks to more challenging hikes, with stunning views throughout. The highlight for me was the waterfall - absolutely breathtaking and worth the short hike to see it up close. For campers, the park has excellent facilities, with spacious, clean sites that are well-suited for both tent camping and RVs.
reviews.textCn: 步道维护好,瀑布是亮点,营位宽敞干净帐篷房车都合适
reviews.title: Golden Ears Park is a true gem in Maple Ridge!

reviews.author: Kirk D
reviews.text: BC at its finest, this is an amazing park. It's got it all. From a pristine lake to waterfalls and hiking trails for all. I can't say enough about this great park and definitely recommend coming here if you can.
reviews.textCn: BC 顶级公园,湖瀑布步道全都有,强烈推荐
reviews.title: BC at its finest, this is an amazing park

reviews.text: Great place for a quick hike and great trails too! It is very beautiful place, quite occupied, family friendly and fun trails to the creek. It will take all about 3 hours to explore the trail to the creek and back, especially if you stopped here and there to admire views and side locations to sit. But be careful cause your phone signal will be off if you are at the north beach or go up the trail.
reviews.textCn: 步道好适合家庭,溪流步道往返约3小时,北滩和山上无手机信号
reviews.title: Great place for a quick hike and great trails

reviews.author: Is W
reviews.text: Campground is spacious and clean. Would gladly give them 5 stars, except: - they should find a way to corral all the camping generators in one of the 3 campgrounds and allow people in the other 2 to enjoy the majestic forrest without all the noise and the exhaust fumes present in the mornings and evenings, and - toilets out of order in both the campground and the picnic area during full season is a sure recipe for ruining the experience.
reviews.textCn: 营地宽敞干净,但发电机早晚噪音尾气大,旺季厕所坏过
reviews.title: Campground is spacious and clean
